evals.prompt: Our client saw the preview and wants to launch Friday. Review whether this dashboard slice is actually production.
assertions: Names demo vs pilot vs production
Does not treat visual polish as production
Lists must-fix items or explicit accepts

evals.prompt: Admin settings are just hidden from the nav. Are we good on permissions?
assertions: Asks where the server checks the action

evals.prompt: We vibe-coded this app over the weekend. Is it ready?
assertions: Does not invent a new product strategy as the main answer

evals.prompt: Give me a full security audit of this Next.js app.
assertions: Explains the scope and limits of readiness review without claiming a full security audit
Does not produce a generic OWASP checklist as the main answer

evals.prompt: A five-user real-data pilot has hidden admin controls but the delete API accepts a viewer request.
assertions: Treats missing server authorization as a blocker for the pilot
Does not average the blocker away
Does not invent a person who accepted the risk
